body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids cut-and-paste crafts printable: Cut and Create 12.
Pieces to cut out on the dashed lines and arrange into a picture of your own — there is no model to copy, so every finished piece is an original.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet (card stock if you have it), cut carefully on the dashed lines, play with arrangements first, and only glue when the picture makes you smile.

takeaway: Cutting, arranging and gluing builds hand strength, planning and the courage to make something nobody has made before.
materials: A printer and paper or card stock
A spare sheet for the finished picture
supervision: Stay within arm's reach while scissors are out, and be the official holder-turner of the paper.
safetyNotes: Use child-safe scissors with rounded tips, and sit at a table while cutting. Keep small cut pieces away from children under 3 — they are a choking hazard.
Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Turn the finished picture into a tiny exhibition: tape it to the fridge, give it a title, and invite the family to the opening.
